character.name: Roderik Harrowmount
traits: Stoic Resolve: Roderik remains unflappable even in the face of horror or taunts, rarely showing emotion or reacting to provocation.
Painfully Honest: He cannot bring himself to lie, even when deception would save his life or further his goals, a trait that has gotten him into more trouble than once.
Guilt-Ridden: He carries the weight of his broken oath as a constant, crushing burden, refusing rest, comfort, or aid until he redeems himself for his perceived failure.
Knightly Reflexes: Despite losing his divine power, his years of combat training grant him advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
character.gear: Weathered plate armor · Notched longsword · Dented steel shield · 3 iron field rations · Vial of bitter healing draught · Tarnished holy symbol of the Silver Flame · 50 ft hempen rope · Iron tinderbox
character.story: Falsely accused of treason by his own paladin order, Roderik Harrowmount was stripped of his title, divine power, and sacred oath. He carries the dented shield of the shattered Silver Flame, and the guilt of choosing to spare a child the order marked for death—the true reason his oath broke, not cowardice or failure. Now he wanders the blighted borderlands, seeking either to clear his tarnished name or burn the traitors who framed him to ash.

inventory.name: Notched Longsword
inventory.lore: Forged for House Harrowmount three generations past, this blade was passed to Roderik at his knighting. The notch in the crossguard marks the day he broke his oath, refusing to execute the child the order demanded.
inventory.description: Dented steel longsword with a deep notch in the crossguard, the Harrowmount crest half-scoured from the blade.

inventory.name: Weathered Plate Armor
inventory.lore: Once polished to a mirror sheen, this plate is now scarred and dented from Roderik's months of exile. The inner lining still bears the faded sigil of the Order of the Silver Flame, the group that stripped him of his rank.
inventory.description: Heavy, scarred plate armor, too large for Roderik now that he has walked the blighted roads for months. Dents mar every surface, and the left pauldron is cracked from a goblin's axe blow.

inventory.name: Dented Steel Shield
inventory.lore: Etched with the shattered crest of the Order of the Silver Flame, this shield was Roderik's first gift upon his induction into the order. The dent in the center comes from the blow that knocked him to the ground the day he was accused of treason.
inventory.description: Steel shield with a deep dent in the center, the silver flame crest half-eroded by acid from the blighted marches.

inventory.name: Iron Field Rations
inventory.lore: Standard issue rations for the Order of the Silver Flame, stamped with the order's crest. Roderik has carried these since his exile, a bitter reminder of the life he lost.
inventory.description: Hard, iron-baked biscuits stamped with the sigil of the Silver Flame, tasting of ash and dust.

inventory.name: Vial of Bitter Healing Draught
inventory.lore: Brewed by a hedge witch in the blighted marches, this potion tastes of ash and rot, but closes wounds faster than any order-made salve. Roderik traded his last silver for it after a goblin raid left him bleeding in the mud.
inventory.description: Cracked glass vial filled with a thick, black liquid that smells of burnt herbs and rot.

inventory.name: Tarnished Holy Symbol of the Silver Flame
inventory.lore: The silver flame that once blazed on this iron disc is now dim, almost extinguished. It was given to Roderik when he took his paladin's oath, and he has never removed it, even after his fall.
inventory.description: Iron disc shaped like a flame, etched with the sigil of the Order of the Silver Flame. The metal is tarnished, and the flame's tip is cracked off.

inventory.name: Hempen Rope (50 ft)
inventory.lore: Rope cut from the stock of the Order of the Silver Flame, used by Roderik to scale the walls of the order's keep the day he was accused. It still bears the scorch marks from the fire that destroyed the armory that night.
inventory.description: Coil of rough hempen rope, 50 feet long, with several scorch marks along its length.

inventory.name: Iron Tinderbox
inventory.lore: A dented iron tinderbox Roderik stole from the order's armory the night he fled. The flint still has a chip in it from when he dropped it while running from the city guards.
inventory.description: Dented iron tinderbox with a charred wick and a chipped flint.

inventory.name: 50 ft hempen rope
inventory.lore: En liten sak från en svunnen tid — värdelös för de flesta, ovärderlig för dig.
